text:
maria-support: Customer on Dedicated VPC reporting repeated 502s to our control plane when routing through their corporate edge proxy. They say this started after their infra team rolled a stricter TLS policy last night.

kevin-net: Can you paste the customer-facing curl + error and any openssl s_client output they provided? Also their proxy vendor?

maria-support: Vendor is "BlueGate" internal appliance. Customer log (sanitized):

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example.com/health
* Connected to proxy.example.corp (10.10.10.10) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.2 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1): no shared cipher
* Received HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.example.com:443 -servername api.redwood.example.com 
CONNECTED(00000003)
139842... error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unknown ca
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.redwood.example.com (ECDSA)
---
---
SSL handshake has read 1024 bytes and written 512 bytes
---

kevin-net: Hmm ECDSA leaf cert + proxy failing with "no shared cipher" / "unknown ca" from s_client. Two quick hypotheses: (1) proxy rejects ECDSA certs / doesn't advertise ECDHE suites to upstream, (2) proxy removes TLS1.3/ALPN bits and forces a legacy cipher list. Can we get a tcpdump of the ClientHello coming from their proxy to our control plane?

maria-support: Customer attached a pcap snippet. Here's the relevant decoded bits they sent (trimmed):

```
ClientHello
 - cipher_suites: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
 - extensions: supported_versions(TLS1.3), supported_groups(x25519, secp256r1)
```

But our servers report receiving a ClientHello with only RSA suites and no supported_groups extension. They think the proxy is re-writing.

robin-ops: If the proxy performs TLS termination and re-initiates upstream, the upstream ClientHello will be from the proxy. BlueGate has a mode that downgrades ECDHE->RSA-only when an HSM doesn't support ECDSA signing for connection rekeys. If the proxy's upstream profile lacks ECDHE or supported_groups, and our server prefers ECDSA cert, then no common key-exchange path exists.

kevin-net: Confirming. Two immediate repro steps we can ask the customer to run (safe):
1) Run openssl s_client directly against the proxy endpoint with -tls1_2 and -cipher 'ECDHE' and dump the ClientHello via tcpdump on our side to compare.
2) Have their infra temporarily enable RSA-based cert on proxy upstream or enable ECDSA ciphers.

maria-support: Sent those repro steps. Customer tried (1) and attached side-by-side diffs: when they curl through proxy, our server logs show ClientHello cipher_suites only contain RSA suites: "RSA-PSK", "RSA-AES128-GCM" etc and no supported_groups. When they bypass proxy (direct peering) the ClientHello contains x25519,secp256r1 and TLS1.3 suites.

robin-ops: That nails it. Actionable fixes: (A) BlueGate config: enable ECDHE upstream ciphers and supported_groups (x25519/secp256r1), or (B) temporarily present an RSA-signed cert on the app side so proxy upstream can negotiate RSA. Longer-term we should: add guidance to our Private deployment docs about proxies that terminate+re-initiate TLS requiring ECDHE and supported_groups, and a diagnostic playbook.

kevin-net: Also add a quick check command for customers to run that shows their proxy's upstream hello via s_client + tcpdump: 
```
# on proxy (or capture at our edge)
tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w /tmp/proxy-clienthello.pcap port 443 and host <our-edge-ip>
# decode
tshark -r /tmp/proxy-clienthello.pcap -Y "ssl.handshake.type==1" -V | sed -n '/Client Hello/,/Cipher Suites/p'
```

maria-support: Customer applied BlueGate change to re-enable ECDHE+curves and redeployed. They report 200s now. They also asked if we can detect this class of mismatch on our side and return a clearer error than generic 502.

robin-ops: We can improve error signals: when TLS handshake fails early with "no shared cipher" and our local TLS stack sees certificate type mismatch (server cert ECDSA + client hello lacking supported_groups), we can log a structured reason and return 502 with header X-SSL-Error: "no-shared-key-exchange:proxy-rewritten-clienthello" for support correlation. Ticket it.

kevin-net: Filed INFRA-1298 to add detection + docs. Assign to net-team and docs.

maria-support: Closing loop with customer, they confirmed fix. I'll attach their config snippet to the ticket for reference. :white_check_mark:
